Inherited nonsyndromic hearing loss; no additional organ involvement is established.

Hypomyelinating neurodegeneration; cataract and hypothyroidism each reported in 1/1 patient. Low B-cell count alone does not establish functional immunodeficiency.

Congenital diaphragmatic muscle defect; associated pulmonary hypoplasia commonly impairs lung function (>30%). Displacement of bowel alone does not establish GI injury.
